preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10.
The length of strings A and B is between 1 and 10^5.
Strings A and B have the same length n.

preconditions.expression: A and B consist of the first 20 lowercase English alphabet letters (a to t).
preconditions.description: Both strings A and B consist of the first 20 lowercase English alphabet letters.

preconditions.expression: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 10^5.
preconditions.description: The sum of the lengths of strings over all test cases does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.expression: Output is -1 if there is no way to make strings A and B equal.
postconditions.description: If it is impossible to make strings A and B equal, the output should be -1.

postconditions.expression: Output is the smallest number of moves to make strings A and B equal if possible.
postconditions.description: If it is possible to make strings A and B equal, the output should be the smallest number of moves.
